
{{alias}}( document, tokens, value )
    Immutably sets a value at a path in a document using structural sharing.

    Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned. All other
    subtrees keep their original references.

    If `tokens` is empty (root pointer), returns `value` directly (root
    replacement).

    Parameters
    ----------
    document: Object|Array
        Source document.

    tokens: Array<string>
        Array of reference tokens.

    value: any
        The value to set.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object|Array
        New document with the value set at the specified path.

    Examples
    --------
    > var doc = { 'a': { 'b': { 'c': 1 } } };
    > var out = {{alias}}( doc, [ 'a', 'b', 'c' ], 99 )
    { 'a': { 'b': { 'c': 99 } } }
    > var bool = ( doc === out )
    false

    See Also
    --------
